meta.name: add-dashboard
meta.description: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw. Installs @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and a pusher that sends periodic JSON snapshots.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 添加 NanoClaw 监控仪表板，定期推送数据快照。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你管理 NanoClaw 并希望实时观测其状态。
copy.tagline_en: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw and stream periodic data snapshots.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage a NanoClaw instance and want to watch its metrics on a dashboard.

howto.what: 装上后,NanoClaw 会多一个本地监控面板,显示代理组、会话、频道、用户、token 用量、上下文窗口、消息活动和实时日志,并通过定时推送数据刷新。
howto.when: 当你说出「给 NanoClaw 添加仪表盘」「安装监控面板」等请求时触发。

say.text: 给 NanoClaw 添加监控仪表盘。
say.note: 会安装依赖、复制文件并接线。

say.text: 安装 @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard 并配置环境变量。
say.note: 会设置 DASHBOARD_SECRET 和端口。

say.text: 把 dashboard-pusher 集成进 src/index.ts。
say.note: 会在 main() 中添加启动代码。

howto.what_en: Adds a local monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw showing agent groups, sessions, channels, users, token usage, context windows, message activity, and real-time logs, refreshed by periodic pushes.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask to add a monitoring dashboard or install the monitoring panel for NanoClaw.

say_en.text: Add a monitoring dashboard to NanoClaw.
Install @nanoco/nanoclaw-dashboard and set up env vars.
